overview: A component for displaying quoted text — pull quotes, testimonials, or referenced passages — in a visually distinct, styled format. Quotes give excerpted content emphasis and separation from surrounding body copy.

whenToUse: To attribute a direct quotation to a source within editorial or documentation content (block type)
To visually call out a compelling excerpt from surrounding prose and draw readers in (pull type)
do: Use the block type for direct quotations where a clear source attribution is known
Use the pull type for striking one- or two-sentence excerpts lifted from the surrounding text
Use the branded variant when the quote needs to carry extra visual weight aligned with the product's primary color
dont: Don't use a quote for non-quotation styled callouts — use a Card or Alert for general highlighted content
Don't omit attribution on block quotes when the source is known; attribution is both an editorial and accessibility expectation
Don't use pull quotes for entire paragraphs — keep them short and impactful to serve their purpose
